warnings: Steel tie-beam (อะเส) plan: the dash-dot linetype is the only member and the หมายเหตุ legend names it 'อะเส rectangular tube Ø-150x75x2.8 mm.'. It carries no mark, so element_id is null with element_name_assigned (section 0.2). A ring-beam/อะเส plan filed under the roof sheet is a beam_plan (section 1 trap list) — the roof frame itself is the separate S-03 sheet. The printed symbol before 150x75x2.8 is a slashed rectangle — read as RHS (house 151/134 precedent), print kept in printed_as.

Lines drawn: rows A, B, C, D and grid 2 (A-D) between the column tops, plus grids 1 and 3 run on 1.00 past row A (to A'') and 1.00 past row D (to D') — the ends sit exactly on the printed 1.00 ticks of this sheet's y chain; those four cantilever ends are recorded as their own segments, flagged overhang. Segments split at the column tops (small squares at all 15 grid points = C1 rising from S-01).

Row E: a separate อะเส E1-E3 on the porch posts at หลังอะเสระดับ +2.78 (leader text), lower than the +3.54 of rows A-D. There is no อะเส between D' and E on grids 1/3 — the porch roof is carried by its own rafters (S-03).
level_m is taken from the sheet title (+3.54, matching ระดับหลังอะเส +3.54 on A-04..A-07) and from the row-E leader (+2.78).
